dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: We're already within Qiaoying Village's borders. Welcome to the home of Liyue's most famous tea!

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: Qiaoying Village is not as bustling as Yilong Wharf, but a quieter, more relaxed place has value all its own.

dialogues.speaker: Moyan
dialogues.text: If you like tea, please give our Sunglo Tea and Single-Origin Yauwan Tea a try. You'll love them!
